claim: In Claude Code's skill listing, Claude's tokenizer averaged about 3 characters a token: on 9 skills, /context counted 1.25 to 1.36 times the tokens a 4-characters-a-token estimate gives (mean 1.32).

sources.title: Our test: /context in Claude Code 2.1.299 on Opus 5.5, against name and description lengths

notes: Counts in /context are rounded to the nearest 10. Other model families count differently; tokens labels every number an estimate.
